title: What is the Cavrnus Metaverse Connector™? | Unreal Fest 2022
description: Learn about a new free-to-integrate UE4/UE5 plugin that helps anyone to easily add spatial collaboration features to new or existing Unreal Engine projects. Explore low/no-code integrations that enable multi-user co-presence, voice/video streaming, dynamic insertion of 3D objects, PDFs, media files and more.
